en.topic_title: China sentences Wuhan ex-mayor to 14 years in prison for bribery conviction
en.topic_summary:
A Chinese court sentenced the former mayor of the central city of Wuhan to 14 years’ imprisonment on Saturday after he was found guilty of accepting bribes in business deals.



Zhou Xianwang, then Wuhan mayor, attends a meeting on December 26, 2020. Photo: Wuhan Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
